newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN BANKS TO LEND HUNGARY 500 MLN MARKS.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN BANKS TO LEND HUNGARY 500 MLN MARKS.

text.p: A German bank consortium on Wednesday extended German government-backed loans totalling 500 million marks to the National Bank of Hungary, the German federal state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said.
The eight-year loans are intended to support investments by German companies in Hungary, the Baden-Wuerttemberg government said.

The bank consortium is led by state-owned banks Suedwestdeutsche Landesbank and Bayerische Landesbank. The loan will be used to provide low-interest credit to subsidiaries of German companies seeking to expand in Hungary.
The loan agreement was signed in Stuttgart by Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn during a meeting with Baden-Wuerttemberg's premier Erwin Teufel.
The loans will be paid out via commercial banks in Hungary.
